system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Tsuchigumo were not always warrior. Your people were craftsmen, tailors and seamstresses. That tradition was never lost, but repurposed. By spending 10 minutes working with your natural Silk, you can construct a traversable structure of your design, filling a 20-foot cube, such as a bridge, rope, ladder platform or something similar. This structure lasts for 1 hour before dissolving. When you construct this structure, you designate any number of creatures that you know who will or might use it. The structure can only support medium or smaller creatures, and any creatures that makes contact with the structure that you did not plan to use it, causes the structure to immediately collapse. Once you create a structure in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest of any type.

Alternatively, over the course of a short or long rest, you can weave a wearable silk garment indistinguishable from high quality clothing. This clothing lasts for up to 24 hours or until in contact with water before dissolving. Non-Hostile creatures that are unfamiliar with the wearer that interacts with them improve their attitude with the wearer by 1 rank due to being impressed by the quality of the clothing. This attitude improvement lasts until a circumstance would logically dispel it.

| Brood Mother / Large Creature, unaligned / Armor Class 20 / Hit Points 100 / Speed 60 ft / | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | / | STR | +4 | +11 | CON | +2 | +5 | WIS | +3 | +6 | / | DEX | +5 | +12 | INT | +4 | +11 | CHA | +2 | +5 | / Damage Immunities Poison / Condition Immunities Charmed, Envenomed. / Senses Darkvision 60ft, passive Perception 25 / Immutable Poison. Poison damage this creature deals cannot be resisted and it treats immunity as resistance. / Spider Climb. The Brood Mother can climb or cross any surface suffering no movement speed penalties. / Attacks / Multiattack. The Brood Mother Arachnid can attack 2 times with its Bite and once with its Web string or it can attack twice with its Web String / Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d10 + 5 Poison damage and once per turn, force the target to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failure. / Web String. The Brood Mother shoots a string of thick webbing at a creature, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature is Grappled and Restrained. / Hatching Brood: The Brood Mother looks to your webbing as places to give new life. It summons a collection of Broodling’s, selecting a number of your Web Anchors currently active, dispelling up to 4, and summoning two Broodling’s per dispelled Web Anchor, each pair in the original spaces of the dispelled Web Anchors. The Broodling’s all follow a single directive. Consume the Brood Mothers prey, by any means. These creatures cannot be controlled by normal means, they simply take cues from their mother attacking whatever their Brood Mother last attacked. These Broodling’s also uses your highest jutsu attack bonus and save DC for abilities that call for it. |
